additional_info.subject: RE: 0411604 - ID0411604-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / R6 170002121] Outlets are Unavailable CRM:00641001198
additional_info.body:
Dear Team,
Hope you are doing well.
As per the reported timestamp, we have reviewed the logs and identified that the charger outlets went out of order due to the following error:
"Error polling coap://10.20.17.101:5683/state Error: No reply in 4.25s,"
which indicates that SECC lite was unable to communicate with the controller.
Kindly refer to the attached images. Based on the timestamp, the disconnection was caused by SECC failure to communicate with the controller.
Incident one-:
Incident 2-:
We have rebooted the charger remotely, and it is now functioning correctly with no error flags raised. Please refer to the attached snapshot for reference.
Kindly confirm so that we can proceed with closing the ticket.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Abhinav Malokar
